entities.name: Martyrs of Korlis
entities.description: Young idealists of Korlis slaughtered by the Fallaji; later a band in Gull's army.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War during which the Martyrs died.

entities.name: Nazarius
entities.description: Fanatic who led a band of Martyrs in Gull's army 4000 years later.

events.summary: The Fallaji slaughter the Martyrs, prompting an Argivian and Korlisian army to march south.
events.quote: Their deaths electrified the southern of the two Combined Kingdoms

events.summary: 4000 years later Nazarius leads a band of Martyrs in Gull's army.
events.quote: a man named Nazarius , a fanatic with misty eyes, led a band of the Martyrs of Korlis

relations.quote: slaughtered by the Fallaji during the Brothers' War
